PROP-oauth-2-0-ut-inv-013.text: already_consented URL parameter must not bypass server-side consent record verification.
PROP-oauth-2-0-ut-inv-013.assertion: consent_grant requires DB rpc check_user_consent == true; URL param alone is insufficient

locations.note: check_user_consent RPC called server-side; result sets already_consented URL param (informational only, no code grant bypass)
Consent form submission always calls create_user_consent + creates auth code — no shortcut path from URL param
